title: docs: juce-factory-elite autonomous JUCE Cloud Agent
body: ## Summary Defines **juce-factory-elite** — the repo’s elite, autonomous **JUCE factory worker** (Track C), distinct from HISE/Antigravity and Gearmulator lanes. | Artifact | Role | |----------|------| | [docs/JUCE_FACTORY_AGENT.md](docs/JUCE_FACTORY_AGENT.md) | Persona, autonomy loop, automation hooks, definition of done | | [.cursor/rules/juce-factory-elite.mdc](.cursor/rules/juce-factory-elite.mdc) | Realtime DSP + `run_business.py --profile ci` gate on JUCE globs | | [docs/prompts/juce-factory-worker.cloud.md](docs/prompts/juce-factory-worker.cloud.md) | Copy-paste Cursor **Cloud Agent** mission | | [scripts/agents/print-juce-factory-prompt.sh](scripts/agents/print-juce-factory-prompt.sh) | CLI bootstrap prompt generator | | GitHub issue template **JUCE factory work order** | Label `juce-factory` → spawn agent | ## How to run (autonomous) 1. [cursor.com/agents](https://cursor.com/agents) → **Instruments** → environment **Disklordz / Instruments** 2. Paste prompt from `docs/prompts/juce-factory-worker.cloud.md` (fill Mission + WO) 3. Or: `./scripts/agents/print-juce-factory-prompt.sh WO-2026-042` Agent commits, runs plugin CI, opens draft PR — no merge without human review. ## Not included Separate binary worker; Cursor Cloud Agent API wiring (documented, keys stay in dashboard).
